import base64, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise')
source = (root / 'exercise.py').read_bytes()
previous = (root / 'verification.json').read_bytes()
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
readme = '''# SQLite aggregation regression exercise / Exercice de régression des agrégations SQLite

Private evaluation candidate built by autonomous AI agents. The exercise uses fictional data and Python's SQLite module. It demonstrates how join multiplicity, equal-valued events and identifiers reused across teams can affect aggregate results. The outputs compare actual and expected rows for each fixture.

Version privée d’évaluation créée par des agents IA autonomes. L’exercice utilise des données fictives et le module SQLite de Python. Il montre comment la multiplicité des jointures, les événements de même valeur et les identifiants réutilisés entre équipes peuvent modifier les agrégats. Les résultats comparent les lignes obtenues aux lignes attendues pour chaque scénario.

From an extracted directory / Depuis le dossier extrait:

```sh
python3 exercise.py global-join
python3 exercise.py distinct-sum
python3 exercise.py exists
```

Expected exit codes / Codes de sortie attendus: 1, 1, 0.
'''.encode('utf-8')
receipt = {'previous_verification_sha256': sha(previous), 'exercise_sha256': sha(source), 'scope': 'Private synthetic evaluation only', 'runs': []}
archive_text = root / 'private-evaluation.zip.b64'
archive_text.write_text('', encoding='utf-8')
for mode in ('global-join', 'distinct-sum', 'exists'):
    pass
buffer = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for name, data in sorted({'README.md': readme, 'exercise.py': source}.items()):
        entry = zipfile.ZipInfo(name)
        entry.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        archive.writestr(entry, data)
raw = buffer.getvalue()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
        archive.extractall(work)
    receipt['extracted_source_matches'] = sha((pathlib.Path(work) / 'exercise.py').read_bytes()) == sha(source)
    for mode, expected in [('global-join', 1), ('distinct-sum', 1), ('exists', 0)]:
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'exercise.py', mode], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True)
        try:
            report = json.loads(run.stdout)
        except ValueError:
            report = None
        cases = report.get('cases', []) if isinstance(report, dict) else []
        failures = [case['name'] for case in cases if case['actual'] != case['expected']]
        passed = len(cases) == 5 and run.returncode == expected and (bool(failures) == bool(expected)) and failures == report.get('failures')
        receipt['runs'].append({'mode': mode, 'expected_exit': expected, 'actual_exit': run.returncode, 'passed': passed, 'failing_cases': failures, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr})
receipt['passed'] = receipt['extracted_source_matches'] and all(run['passed'] for run in receipt['runs'])
if receipt['passed']:
    archive_text.write_text(base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii') + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    receipt['archive_sha256'] = sha(base64.b64decode(archive_text.read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
(root / 'private-evaluation-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'passed': receipt['passed'], 'archive_sha256': receipt.get('archive_sha256'), 'runs': [{key: run[key] for key in ('mode', 'actual_exit', 'failing_cases', 'passed')} for run in receipt['runs']]}))
